original: tato 'dhigatavastuniścayād vyastasamastavibhāvitārthapraguṇīkaraṇam iti trisarvajñatānukramastho 'nupūrvābhisamayaḥ | tato viśeṣagamanābhāvāt trisarvajñatāniṣṭhāvasthaḥ samyagekakṣaṇābhisambodhaḥ | tatas tasya phalam iti trisarvajñatāvipāko dharmakāyaḥ sakāritra ity aparaḥ ṣaṭprakāro 'rthasaṃgrahaḥ |
analyzed: tatas dhigata vastu niścayāt vyasta samasta vibhāvita artha praguṇīkaraṇam iti tri sarvajña tā anukrama sthaḥ nupūrva abhisamayaḥ tatas viśeṣa gamana abhāvāt tri sarvajña tā niṣṭhā avasthaḥ samyak eka kṣaṇa abhisambodhaḥ tatas tasya phalam iti tri sarvajña tā vipākaḥ dharmakāyaḥ sa kāritraḥ iti aparaḥ ṣaṣ prakāraḥ rtha saṃgrahaḥ

original: [60] pūrvavad eva kṛtavyākhyaḥ sarvasyā mātur iti | madhyarucisattvānugraheṇaivaṃ ṣaḍarthasaṃgrahadvāreṇa vyākhyāya punar anyathāsaṃkṣiptarucisattvānugraheṇa vyākhyānam āha |
analyzed: pūrvavat eva kṛta vyākhyaḥ sarvasyāḥ mātuḥ iti madhya ruci sattva anugraheṇa evam ṣaḍartha saṃgraha dvāreṇa vyākhyāya punar anyathā saṃkṣipta ruci sattva anugraheṇa vyākhyānam āha
viṣayaḥ tritayaḥ hetuḥ prayogaḥ catur ātmakaḥ
dharma kāya phalam karma iti anyaḥ traidhārtha saṃgrahaḥ

original: iti | ādau sarvākārajñatāditrisarvajñatārthabhāvaḥ pravṛttigocaratvād viṣayaḥ | hetuḥ sa kathaṃ prayujyata iti tadanantaraṃ sarvākārābhisambodhādiś caturvidho 'bhisamayaprayogaḥ | tasyaivaṃ prayogavato hetoḥ kiṃ phalam iti tadanu dharmakāyaḥ sakarmaḥ phalam ity aparas trividho 'rthasaṃgrahas tathaiva kṛtavyākhyās trividhāyā jinajananyā iti |  |
analyzed: iti ādau sarva ākāra jña tā ādi tri sarvajña tā artha bhāvaḥ pravṛtti gocara tvāt viṣayaḥ hetuḥ sa katham prayujyate iti tad anantaram sarva ākāra abhisambodha ādiḥ caturvidhaḥ bhisamaya prayogaḥ tasya evam prayogavataḥ hetoḥ kim phalam iti tadanu dharmakāyaḥ sa karmaḥ phalam iti aparaḥ trividhaḥ rtha saṃgrahaḥ tathā eva kṛta vyākhyāḥ trividhāyāḥ jina jananyāḥ iti

original: [61] prajñāpāramitopadeśaśāstrābhisamayālaṃkāravivṛtiḥ prajñāpradīpāvalī samāptā || || śubham astu | namaḥ sarvagurubuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ || || kṛtir iyaṃ vyākhyātṛmahāpaṇḍitabuddhaśrījñānapādānām iti || ||
analyzed: prajñāpāramitā upadeśa śāstra abhisamaya alaṃkāra vivṛtiḥ prajñāpradīpa āvalī samāptā śubham astu namaḥ sarva guru buddha bodhisattvebhyaḥ kṛtiḥ iyam vyākhyātṛ mahā paṇḍita buddha śrī jñāna pādānām iti
